answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 29905 Country: India Title: My daughter name is shazia saleem i want to know what is the meaning of name and this name is good or not my husband didn't ask anybody when he choose the name. plz send me replay soon. Question: ASSALMUALAIKUM, My daughter name is shazia saleem i want to know what is the meaning of name and this name is good or not my husband didn't ask anybody when he choose the name. plz send me replay soon. jazakallah Answer ID: 29905 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 281/208/L=1432) Shazia means: a female who spread fragrance. In itself, this name is good; however if you chose a name from among the names of the holy wives, holy daughters or Sahabiyat, it is far better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
